item: row 361 group 2: the P0 validation, release run, unattended and perception-eval status lines and reports follow a language switch
summary: Settings -> Advanced -> Diagnostics: the P0 validation, release run, unattended-mode and live perception-eval panels wrote t() output into ordinary nodes, so after a language switch their status lines and reports stayed in the language they were drawn in. They now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml (row 364): each status helper takes a render instead of a string, and the two report renderers build their HTML in _p0ResultHtml/_rrReportHtml. A switch redraws from what each panel last showed and never polls. The release-run poller's interrupted line keeps its own resume plan, so a redraw says what that reading said. The release-run node test now proves the report follows a switch. Covered beyond the list: releaseRunCollect, releaseRunResume and _rrPoll froze too but were hidden from the scanner, because their writes sat in a set = (m) => {...} closure (a unit with a sink and no t()) while the t() calls sat in the caller (no sink). Nine lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt. No new strings.
